page_title: Lafz Prompter: free Mac teleprompter under the notch

sources.entry: Lafz Prompter - Teleprompter that sits under the MacBook notch, can hide from screen sharing, scrolls as you speak, and shows Urdu in Nastaliq. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ranawaqas-ai/lafz-prompter) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: Lafz Prompter
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source teleprompter for macOS that sits under the MacBook notch, scrolls as you speak, and can be hidden from screen recordings and screen sharing.
use_cases: Reading a script under the camera during Zoom or Google Meet calls
Recording videos while reading from notes without the script appearing on screen
Reading Urdu scripts in Nastaliq font
Loading a screenplay in Fountain format to read on set
Presenting talks with auto-scrolling text that follows your voice
summary.what_it_does: Lafz Prompter runs from the menu bar and shows a script in a window positioned under the notch on a MacBook, or at the top of other displays, so the reader looks near the camera. It can scroll with voice activation, pausing when the speaker pauses, or at a manually set speed adjustable with keyboard shortcuts. Scripts can be opened from text, Markdown, Word, OpenDocument, RTF, HTML, PDF and Fountain files, or pasted from the clipboard. The prompter can be hidden from screen recordings and screen sharing so only the user sees it. The Automatic font displays Urdu in Nastaliq, and other installed fonts can be chosen.
notable: Sits under the MacBook notch and can be hidden from screen recordings and screen sharing
Voice-activated scrolling that pauses when you pause
Supports Urdu in Nastaliq font and Fountain screenplays
Open source under GPLv3; a fork of NotchPrompter, which is paid on the Mac App Store
caveats: Voice-activated scrolling is an option that must be turned on; otherwise scrolling uses a set speed
Not affiliated with or endorsed by NotchPrompter
